task_instance: Act on a 'my Mac disk is full, clean up the safe stuff' request: run the skill's read-only survey (python3 scripts/survey.py --json) to report disk free and safe/medium recoverable totals and top targets, then run the executor (python3 scripts/clean.py --preset safe --go) to trash regenerable safe caches and relay freed space.
blocker_detail: The skill is deterministic by design: its entire core deliverable (measuring sizes with du and trashing/cleaning paths) is performed by executing the bundled Python scripts survey.py and clean.py, which call out to OS utilities (du, trash, docker, xcrun simctl) on a live macOS filesystem. The office-assistant runtime grants only reading/writing/editing text files and web fetch/search; it cannot run code, scripts, or shell commands of any kind, so neither survey.py nor clean.py can be executed and no actual scan or cleanup can be produced or verified. (Secondary: the runtime is also not macOS and has no such caches, but code execution is the decisive blocker — the skill explicitly states a user runs these scripts headless in a terminal.) The skill's own files (survey.py, clean.py, lib.py, targets.json, config.json) are all present, so this is not a missing-skill-file case; writing a replacement that merely reads the text would not be running the skill's deterministic tooling and is forbidden by the run rules.
evidence: Read SKILL.md: states 'All measuring and deleting lives in scripts/survey.py (read-only) and scripts/clean.py (executor)' and documents the only invocation path as 'python3 scripts/survey.py --json' and 'python3 scripts/clean.py --preset safe --go'. Glob of the skill folder confirms scripts/survey.py, scripts/clean.py, scripts/lib.py, targets.json and config.json all exist. Attempting the chosen task requires executing python3 against these scripts to compute du sizes and trash paths; the runtime forbids running any code or shell command, and the task rules forbid writing my own stub/replacement of the scripts or fabricating their output. No deliverable could therefore be produced or verified. No files beyond this result.json were created in the work directory.
